responsibility: Implements symbol mangling for Rust entities emitted by the GCC Rust backend. It currently provides the legacy mangling algorithm that encodes canonical paths, generic and qualified-path syntax, and a type-derived hash into linker symbol names, while also scaffolding a future v0 mangling scheme and exposing the logic used by item and extern compilation to choose assembler names.
same_name_distinction: Defines the mangler implementation and algorithm details for the rust-mangle interface, including the legacy encoding, hashing, version dispatch, and partial v0 support; unlike rust-mangle.h, it provides the executable symbol-construction logic rather than just the Mangler API and version-selection declarations.
